record_type_quote: In four studies we replicated the original Zhong & Liljenquist’s experiments with Spanish samples.

targets.title: Washing away your sins: Threatened morality and physical cleansing.
targets.evidence_quote: In this paper we replicate the four experiments of Zhong and Liljenquist (2006), with Spanish participants, trying to examine the universality of physical cleansing as a way of restoring morality.
targets.outcome_quote: We were unsuccessful in replicating the Zhong & Liljenquist´s results that supported cleansing as a psychological mechanism for compensating guilty: results couldn’t confirm an increased mental accessibility of cleansing-related concepts or even a greater desire for cleansing products, neither a greater likelihood of taking antiseptic wipes.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicit overall failure verdict applies to the single original paper.

reasoning: Identity and authors verified in full article; four new Spanish samples retest one published paper.
